opening.argument: The promotion ties OneCoin participation to recruitment-based rewards and urgent registration. Viewers are told they can qualify for bonuses by becoming active marketing partners and building a sales team, while a registration form invites them to join the ONE network. It also presents a token portfolio as capable of doubling and increasing in value in just under 10 weeks, creating an optimistic financial appeal alongside a tiered recruitment structure. These claims establish the promotional scheme, although the evidence does not show payment requirements, actual payouts, or what registration ultimately produces.
